notes.title: Version 1.2 has been released!
notes.content:
What's new:

- Relaxed game mode. No more timers and level defeats through a lot of mistakes. You may enable it on Options screen.
- New shiny effects  on riddles rows completing.
- Better game fonts representation. 
- Antivirus false detection has been fixed.
- Lot of minor bugs fixed.

Hope you will enjoy it!

Best Regards,
Oleg Sereda
